text:
amanda: Heads up — our weekly eng sync tomorrow at 09:00 PT looks doubled up in a bunch of people's calendars. I think someone exported an .ics and re-created it in a different timezone. Anyone else seeing two invites? :raised_hand:

josh: yeah that's me — I tried to create a recurring copy for APAC folks but Google kept converting times. I exported an .ics and reimported, so we ended up with both events. Sorry about the mess.

sophia: I just noticed Zoom link is different on the duplicate — one has the old long link, the other the new meeting id. That'll be chaos if people join the wrong one.

lia: calendar-bot shows two active events, both recurring. One TZ = America/Los_Angeles, other TZ = Etc/GMT+8 (weird conversion).

calendar-bot: Duplicate event detected: event_a (owner:josh) vs event_b (owner:josh_copy). Recurrence rule mismatch. Suggested action: consolidate and resend invites.

josh: Is there a simple fix? I can delete one but worried about people who RSVP'd to that copy.

amanda: Let's not delete immediately. Proposed plan:
1) Pick a canonical event (the one with updated Zoom + correct attendee list).
2) Explicitly set the event timezone to America/Los_Angeles (PT) on the canonical event.
3) Update recurrence rule to weekly on Tue 09:00 PT and leave guests allowed to modify.
4) Resend invites and ask folks to decline the duplicate.
Anyone object?

sophia: No objections. Also recommend we add a short note in the description telling people which invite to decline.

lia: For future: don't export/import .ics to change timezone. Use event settings -> Time zone -> add secondary TZ, or use "Find a time" in GCal. Export/import will hardcode the timestamps relative to the source TZ and cause duplicates.

josh: Got it. I'll be canonical owner and resend. Will copy Zoom details into the canonical event and add the decline note.

josh: (adding description snippet now)

```
Description:
Canonical event (owner: josh).
If you see a duplicate with subject "Eng Sync (recreated)", please decline that invite.
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/123456789
Time zone: America/Los_Angeles
Guests can modify: true
```

amanda: :thumbsup: thanks. Can we also add a one-sentence calendar tip at the top: "If you're scheduling across time zones, set the event's primary timezone explicitly (do not rely on export/import)."

sophia: I'll extend the reminder from 15 -> 30 minutes for the canonical event so APAC folks get an earlier heads-up.

lia: I'll add a short how-to in devex playbook about timezone-safe edits and link it in the event description.

josh: Done — canonical event created, invites resent with the note. I'll keep the duplicate in my calendar for 24 hours and then delete it after folks have had time to decline.

amanda: Perfect. Thanks everyone for the quick turn. Closing loop — will announce in #general morning. :raised_hands:

calendar-bot: Notification: Event "Eng Sync" created by josh at 1771234680. Recurrence set weekly, timezone America/Los_Angeles.
